quantize_4bit_tensor: quantize a torch tensor to 4-bit nf4 or fp4 format using blockwise quantization
dequantize_4bit_tensor: dequantize a 4-bit packed tensor back to its original float dtype
run_int8_scaled_mm: run int8 matrix multiply with row and column stats dequantization and optional bias
quantize_int8_vectorwise: quantize a float tensor to int8 with per-row scaling and optional outlier column handling
run_optimizer_update_32bit: run a 32-bit optimizer update for adam, lion, momentum, rmsprop, adagrad, or ademamix
